Select 1 enemy in your Teleporter Capability range, each making a contested Focus Check. If you succeed, you and the target swap places, similar to Ally Switch.

clauses.text: Stat Maneuver's Effect depends on your Chosen Stat: Attack
You may activate this Feature to cause one of your Pokemon to use a Physical “Melee, 1-Target” Move as if its range was “Melee, Pass” or “Melee, 3-Targets” instead. Defense

You may activate this feature whenever your Pokemon is hit by a Physical Attack to receive the blow as if your Pokemon's Defense Combat Stages were at +6 instead of their current value. Special Attack

You may activate this Feature to allow your Pokemon to use a Special Burst, Cone, Close Blast, Ranged Blast, or Line of any size as a Burst 1, Cone 2, Close Blast 2, or Line 4 instead. Special Defense
You may activate this feature whenever your Pokemon is hit by a Special Attack to receive the blow as if your Pokemon's Special Defense Combat Stages were at +6 instead of their current value. Speed
You may activate this Feature at any time to cause your Pokemon to use a Move as Priority or a Priority Move as Priority (Advanced).

Declare a target, you and your Pokémon take a Full Action to shift and then attack the target. If it does not, both you and your Pokemons HP is set to 1 and you both gain an injury.

Trigger: You attempt to capture a Pokémon while in stealth.

Effect: You gain a +X bonus to the accuracy check to hit the Pokémon on top of any bonuses from stealth, where X equals (your stealth rank/2)+1. The Pokémon counts as having the Blinded and Vulnerable condition for the sake of calculating the capture DC, if the target was already Blinded, instead they are now also Totally Blinded. As this only applies to the capture roll, this cannot be negated by Blindsense.

fieldReview.recordValue: Effect: Your Rock-Type Pokémon may activate Igneous Tactics as a Standard Action. They freely Shift as though Flying for a number of meters up to your Type-Linked Skill, either moving to an empty square or colliding with another creature. On collision, the user makes a "Melee, 1 Target" Physical attack with an AC of 2, causing the creature to to lose HP equal to the level of Igneous Tactics' user, and become Grounded for 3 Rounds. Unlike similar set damage effects, this collision attack benefits from Bigger and Boulder and Heavy as Schist, as well as any other effects that affect "Melee, 1 Target" and Physical attacks. Neither your Pokemon nor any others collided with suffer fall damage after resolving Igneous Tactics.

clauses.text: Your Pokemon have their Chosen Base Stat increased by +1, and by +1 more for every 10 Levels they have (for example, a Level 20 Pokemon would have your Chosen Stat's base value increased by +3). Additionally, your Pokemon may ignore Base Relations, as long as they are adding to the Stat chosen for Stat Ace, and you do not need to “correct” Stats due to this inflated Stat Value.

When you take Stat Ace, choose Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, or Speed. This becomes your Pokemon's Chosen Stat. You may take Stat Ace multiple times, choosing different Stats each time. If using Style Expert to qualify for Stat Ace, your Chosen Stat must be the Stat that correlates to your Chosen Contest Stat. Beauty is Special Attack, Cool is Attack, Cute is Speed, Smart is Special Defense, and Tough is Defense. You may use the Stat in place of "Stat" in all Stat Ace features on this sheet, e.g. "Attack Ace" or "Special Defense Link".

fieldReview.recordValue:
When you pickup this feature, choose one of your Elemental Connections.

The Target gains the Type of your chosen Elemental Connection as an additional Type, or has one of their Types replaced by that Type. A Pokémon may be targeted by the same instance of Type Sync only once.

Note: You may take Type Sync multiple times. Each time, you must choose a different Elemental Connection.

*Type-Linked Classes include Type Ace and all Elementalist Classes, all of which are linked to their respective Types. Additionally, Aura Guardian is linked to Fighting; and Telekinetic, Telepath, and Warper are linked to Psychic. Obviously, your Type Linked Class must match your Elemental Connection to apply for Type Sync!

**Note, Type Sync cannot shift Pokemon to the Shadow Type.

fieldReview.recordValue:
Target: The remains of a Fossil you revived
Effect: You produce a "Primal" Item from the remnants of the Fossil. The effect of a Primal Item is based on the highest Base Stat of the individual Pokémon being Revived, counting the effects of Nature but no other effects that alter Base Stats. If there is a tie, the GM decides which Base Stat is used. A Fossil Pokémon may hold a single Primal Item without taking up their Held Item slot, but cannot hold two of same Primal Item this way.
- HP – Primal Crest: The holder gains a +3 Bonus to all Save Checks.
- Attack – Primal Razors: The holder’s Critical Hit Range is extended by +1.
- Defense – Primal Spines: When the holder is hit with a damaging Melee Attack, the attacker loses a Tick of Hit Points.
- Special Attack – Primal Proboscis: The holder’s Effect Range is extended by +1.
- Special Defense – Primal Shell: The holder gains 10 Damage Reduction against Ranged Attacks.
- Speed – Primal Fins: The holder gains +2 Evasion against Status Moves.

fieldReview.recordValue:
Effect: You may use Intuition instead of Survival to Scout an area and find what Wild Pokémon are living there.
Bonus: If your Intuition is Adept Rank or higher, you may also use Intuition instead of Survival to try and find Mega Stones, Z Stones and Type Gems following the rules of finding Pokémon Fossils.
If your Intuition is Expert Rank or higher, your DM can choose to have spirits of passed away Pokémon or people appear and talk to you. Try and see if you can help these spirits pass to the realms beyond by fulfilling last requests.

clauses.text: Your Pokemon have their Chosen Base Stat increased by +1, and by +1 more for every 10 Levels they have (for example, a Level 20 Pokemon would have your Chosen Stat's base value increased by +3). Additionally, your Pokemon may ignore Base Relations, as long as they are adding to the Stat chosen for Stat Ace, and you do not need to “correct” Stats due to this inflated Stat Value.

When you take Stat Ace, choose Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, or Speed. This becomes your Pokemon's Chosen Stat. You may take Stat Ace multiple times, choosing different Stats each time. If using Style Expert to qualify for Stat Ace, your Chosen Stat must be the Stat that correlates to your Chosen Contest Stat. Beauty is Special Attack, Cool is Attack, Cute is Speed, Smart is Special Defense, and Tough is Defense. You may use the Stat in place of "Stat" in all Stat Ace features on this sheet, e.g. "Attack Ace" or "Special Defense Link".

fieldReview.recordValue:
Effect: When using a Snag Ball on a non-Shadow-Type Pokémon, you do not have the usual Accuracy penalty when using Snag Balls.

Bonus: If you succeed at capturing a Trainer’s Pokémon with a Snag Ball, roll a DC 18 Stealth check. If you succeed, the Pokemon's starting Friendship is 2.

Note: Shadow Pokémon still have a starting Friendship Level of 0 when caught, regardless of the effects of this feature.

fieldReview.recordValue:
Trigger: You enter Hyper Mode.
Effect: Your Hyper Mode becomes significantly more potent, becoming something akin to a transformation or a Forme Change. But now you carry the weight of your destroyer’s might, even when at rest.
When you enter Hyper Mode, you instead enter Apex Hyper Mode, receiving the following abilities and conditions in addition to those normally conferred by Hyper Mode:
»» You gain six Combat Stages, but lose four, split between the Stats of your choice, with a maximum of two Stage granted or lost per Combat Stat. You cannot grant Combat Stages in a Stat, and then choose to lose them in that same Stat. You may also assign these Combat Stages to your Accuracy or Evasion.
»» When you inflict a Critical Hit, you deal +20 damage on the Attack, but you suffer 1 Injury.
»» You heal a Tick of Hit Points at the start of each of your turns.
»» For the duration of the Mode, you have the Hustle and Bully Abilities.

However, this barely-fettered brutality confers a number of penalties to your existence outside of combat:
»» Social interaction tests (excluding uses of Intimidate) are innately more difficult for you. Conversely, you gain +4 to your Intimidate rolls.
»» Your natural healing rate is halved, meaning your heal 1/8th of your Hit Points every two hours. Additionally, you can only heal 2 Injuries per day, instead of the normally allowable 3.
»» After an Extended Rest, you only regain half of your Drained AP, up to a minimum of 1.
»» The intensity of your malicious aura even scars your surroundings. Upon using Apex Hyper Mode, you leave Psychic Residue in the spaces you are in or move through. The residue persists for 10 days.

clauses.text: Stat Maneuver's Effect depends on your Chosen Stat: Attack
You may activate this Feature to cause one of your Pokemon to use a Physical “Melee, 1-Target” Move as if its range was “Melee, Pass” or “Melee, 3-Targets” instead. Defense

You may activate this feature whenever your Pokemon is hit by a Physical Attack to receive the blow as if your Pokemon's Defense Combat Stages were at +6 instead of their current value. Special Attack

You may activate this Feature to allow your Pokemon to use a Special Burst, Cone, Close Blast, Ranged Blast, or Line of any size as a Burst 1, Cone 2, Close Blast 2, or Line 4 instead. Special Defense
You may activate this feature whenever your Pokemon is hit by a Special Attack to receive the blow as if your Pokemon's Special Defense Combat Stages were at +6 instead of their current value. Speed
You may activate this Feature at any time to cause your Pokemon to use a Move as Priority or a Priority Move as Priority (Advanced).

You may activate this Feature to cause one of your Pokemon to use a Physical “Melee, 1-Target” Move as if its range was “Melee, Pass” or “Melee, 3-Targets” instead. Defense

You may activate this feature whenever your Pokemon is hit by a Physical Attack to receive the blow as if your Pokemon's Defense Combat Stages were at +6 instead of their current value. Special Attack

You may activate this Feature to allow your Pokemon to use a Special Burst, Cone, Close Blast, Ranged Blast, or Line of any size as a Burst 1, Cone 2, Close Blast 2, or Line 4 instead. Special Defense
You may activate this feature whenever your Pokemon is hit by a Special Attack to receive the blow as if your Pokemon's Special Defense Combat Stages were at +6 instead of their current value. Speed
You may activate this Feature at any time to cause your Pokemon to use a Move as Priority or a Priority Move as Priority (Advanced).

fieldReview.recordValue:
Target: Your Psychic-Type Pokémon
Effect: While this Feature is Bound, you gain a Power Token each time the target uses a Status move or activates a non-Static Ability (Power Tokens are lost when spent, or when Combat ends). As a Standard Action during their turn, or as a Rapid Action during their turn by spending 1 AP, the user may spend any number of their Power Tokens to apply conditions to a foe or ally within X meters, where X is equal to your Type-Linked Skill Rank plus 2.

- 1 Power Token: The target loses/gains a Combat Stage in a Stat of your choice.
- 2 Power Tokens: The target loses/gains a Combat Stage in two different Stats of your choice.
- 3 Power Tokens: The target loses/gains 2 Combat Stages in a Stat of your choice.
- 4 Power Tokens: The target loses a Status Affliction, and gives it to another creature in range.
- 5 Power Tokens: The target has its Combat Stages reset to their defaults.

clauses.text: Your Pokemon have their Chosen Base Stat increased by +1, and by +1 more for every 10 Levels they have (for example, a Level 20 Pokemon would have your Chosen Stat's base value increased by +3). Additionally, your Pokemon may ignore Base Relations, as long as they are adding to the Stat chosen for Stat Ace, and you do not need to “correct” Stats due to this inflated Stat Value.

When you take Stat Ace, choose Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, or Speed. This becomes your Pokemon's Chosen Stat. You may take Stat Ace multiple times, choosing different Stats each time. If using Style Expert to qualify for Stat Ace, your Chosen Stat must be the Stat that correlates to your Chosen Contest Stat. Beauty is Special Attack, Cool is Attack, Cute is Speed, Smart is Special Defense, and Tough is Defense.

fieldReview.recordValue:
Scene x3 – Free Action
Target: Your Pokémon within 5m.
Effect: For each of your Skills (Athletics, Acrobatics and Combat) Adept and above, you and your Pokémon gain the following (Choose one when activating, of applicable Skills):
Athletics – All movement capabilities are doubled for this round and halved for the next. (at Master Athletics, ignore halving movement)
Acrobatics – Your Pokémon gains evasion equal to its Weary and you gain half that (Rounded Down) until the end of your respective turns. (at Master Acro, You double all evasion gains from this feature.)
Combat – All Physical moves (For you and your active Pokémon) Trip on a 18+ for the remainder of the Scene. Tripped Pokémon that would be Tripped again, lose a Tick of Hit Points instead. (at Master Combat, Trip becomes 16+)
Each of these effects can only be used once per scene.
For all Effects, your Pokémon loses 1 Spirit, if they become Weary, they gain +1 CS of your choice.

fieldReview.recordValue:
Target: Your Pokémon
Effect: You must have a Berserk Gene. The target Pokémon gains Shadow Type and becomes a Shadow Pokémon, granting the target all of the traits and restrictions inherent to Shadow Pokémon. The target Pokémon's Friendship is reduced to 0 as a result of this process.

Additionally, you can replace up to 2 moves with a Shadow Type move from the Shadow Pokémon Move List. For those Moves that are replaced by Shadow Moves, the replacements can be moves from the official Shadow Movelist, or be versions of the Pokémon’s existing Moves made into Shadow Moves, adhering to the following restrictions:

»» Damaging Moves can only be replaced by a Shadow Move whose DB is less than or equal to the replaced Move, and maintain the same damage class (Physical or Special).
»» Status Moves can only be replaced by Status class Shadow Moves of the same frequency of the base move.

clauses.text: Your Pokemon have their Chosen Base Stat increased by +1, and by +1 more for every 10 Levels they have (for example, a Level 20 Pokemon would have your Chosen Stat's base value increased by +3). Additionally, your Pokemon may ignore Base Relations, as long as they are adding to the Stat chosen for Stat Ace, and you do not need to “correct” Stats due to this inflated Stat Value.

When you take Stat Ace, choose Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, or Speed. This becomes your Pokemon's Chosen Stat. You may take Stat Ace multiple times, choosing different Stats each time. If using Style Expert to qualify for Stat Ace, your Chosen Stat must be the Stat that correlates to your Chosen Contest Stat. Beauty is Special Attack, Cool is Attack, Cute is Speed, Smart is Special Defense, and Tough is Defense. You may use the Stat in place of "Stat" in all Stat Ace features on this sheet, e.g. "Attack Ace" or "Special Defense Link".

clauses.text: Your Pokemon have their Chosen Base Stat increased by +1, and by +1 more for every 10 Levels they have (for example, a Level 20 Pokemon would have your Chosen Stat's base value increased by +3). Additionally, your Pokemon may ignore Base Relations, as long as they are adding to the Stat chosen for Stat Ace, and you do not need to “correct” Stats due to this inflated Stat Value.

When you take Stat Ace, choose Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, or Speed. This becomes your Pokemon's Chosen Stat. You may take Stat Ace multiple times, choosing different Stats each time. If using Style Expert to qualify for Stat Ace, your Chosen Stat must be the Stat that correlates to your Chosen Contest Stat. Beauty is Special Attack, Cool is Attack, Cute is Speed, Smart is Special Defense, and Tough is Defense. You may use the Stat in place of "Stat" in all Stat Ace features on this sheet, e.g. "Attack Ace" or "Special Defense Link".

clauses.text: Your Pokemon have their Chosen Base Stat increased by +1, and by +1 more for every 10 Levels they have (for example, a Level 20 Pokemon would have your Chosen Stat's base value increased by +3). Additionally, your Pokemon may ignore Base Relations, as long as they are adding to the Stat chosen for Stat Ace, and you do not need to “correct” Stats due to this inflated Stat Value.

When you take Stat Ace, choose Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, or Speed. This becomes your Pokemon's Chosen Stat. You may take Stat Ace multiple times, choosing different Stats each time. If using Style Expert to qualify for Stat Ace, your Chosen Stat must be the Stat that correlates to your Chosen Contest Stat. Beauty is Special Attack, Cool is Attack, Cute is Speed, Smart is Special Defense, and Tough is Defense.

Your Pokémon gain access to an additional table to spend Spirit from.
Bonus: Original Table Spirit Costs are reduced by 1 to a minimum of 1.

Name	Spirit Cost	Effect
Recall	Varies	        Use any move in the Pokemons Level-Up List. 1 Spirit for At-Will and EOT, 2 Spirit for Scene, 3 Spirit for Daily. This move cannot already be on its move list.
Baton Pass	3	When this Pokemon faints, it grants all CS stats to the next Pokemon.
Patched Up	3	Recover 50% max Hp and 1 Injury (does not count towards limit for the day)
Stolen Idea	2	Use Copycat or Snatch, ignoring Frequency
Perfect Skills	2	Your next skill check is a max roll
Intercept+	1	You resist the attack you are intercepting 1 step further.
Helping Hand	1	Use Helping Hand as if it was on your move list, ignoring Frequency and as a Free Action.

clauses.text: Your Pokemon
While this Feature is Bound, the target has the following bonuses based on your Chosen Stat: Attack
The target's damaging Melee Attacks have their Critical Hit Range increased by 1 for each positive Combat Stage they have in Attack, up to a maximum of +3. Defense
The target gains a +2 bonus to Save Checks against Paralysis, Sleep, and Freeze for each positive Combat Stage they have in Defense, up to a maximum of +6. Special Attack
The target's damaging Ranged Attacks have their Effect Range increased by 1 for each positive Combat Stage they have in Special Attack, up to a maximum of +3. Special Defense
The target gains a +2 bonus to Save Checks against Confusion, Rage, and Infatuation for each positive Combat Stage they have in Special Defense, up to a maximum of +6. Speed
The target's Movement Capabilities are increased by 1 for each positive Combat Stage they have in Speed, up to a maximum of +3.

clauses.text: Stat Maneuver's Effect depends on your Chosen Stat: Attack
You may activate this Feature to cause one of your Pokemon to use a Physical “Melee, 1-Target” Move as if its range was “Melee, Pass” or “Melee, 3-Targets” instead. Defense

You may activate this feature whenever your Pokemon is hit by a Physical Attack to receive the blow as if your Pokemon's Defense Combat Stages were at +6 instead of their current value. Special Attack

You may activate this Feature to allow your Pokemon to use a Special Burst, Cone, Close Blast, Ranged Blast, or Line of any size as a Burst 1, Cone 2, Close Blast 2, or Line 4 instead. Special Defense
You may activate this feature whenever your Pokemon is hit by a Special Attack to receive the blow as if your Pokemon's Special Defense Combat Stages were at +6 instead of their current value. Speed
You may activate this Feature at any time to cause your Pokemon to use a Move as Priority or a Priority Move as Priority (Advanced).

clauses.text: Stat Maneuver's Effect depends on your Chosen Stat: Attack
You may activate this Feature to cause one of your Pokemon to use a Physical “Melee, 1-Target” Move as if its range was “Melee, Pass” or “Melee, 3-Targets” instead. Defense

You may activate this feature whenever your Pokemon is hit by a Physical Attack to receive the blow as if your Pokemon's Defense Combat Stages were at +6 instead of their current value. Special Attack

You may activate this Feature to allow your Pokemon to use a Special Burst, Cone, Close Blast, Ranged Blast, or Line of any size as a Burst 1, Cone 2, Close Blast 2, or Line 4 instead. Special Defense
You may activate this feature whenever your Pokemon is hit by a Special Attack to receive the blow as if your Pokemon's Special Defense Combat Stages were at +6 instead of their current value. Speed
You may activate this Feature at any time to cause your Pokemon to use a Move as Priority or a Priority Move as Priority (Advanced).

fieldReview.recordValue:
You designate an unobstructed 3m x 3m area within vision as a Warp Point. This area must be clear of any Blocking Terrain when creating the Warp Point. You may freely maintain a number of Warp Points up to half your Focus Skill Rank. Creating a new Warp Point past this number causes the oldest Warp Point to disappear. You can maintain additional Warp Points, Binding 2 AP for each additional Warp Point beyond half your Focus Skill Rank.

By taking a Full Action, you can Warp to any Warp Point you have created, travelling instantaneously to one of the squares within the Warp Point. Additionally, you can designate any number of allies within your Teleporter Capability range to Warp with you. You can only Warp once per day. If attempting to Warp in combat, you must roll a DC 18 Focus check. On a failure, you may Warp to an unintended location up to your GM's discretion.

fieldReview.recordValue:
Effect: Until the end of the scene, you and your Pokémon can speak to each other fluently, as if you shared a language. Others cannot understand this language; to them, it sounds like a meaningless series of sounds unless they have other ways of understanding you or your Pokémon.

Bonus: You gain a +1d6 to Guile, Charm, and Intimidate checks against Pokémon who have a member of their evolutionary family in your Pokedex. If you have the Mystic senses trait, you gain a 1d6 bonus to using it replace a Guile, Charm, or Intimidate check against those Pokémon.

Note: If your game doesn't use or heavily feature Pokédex’s, any Pokémon that the trainer has seen before qualifies

clauses.text: Your Pokemon have their Chosen Base Stat increased by +1, and by +1 more for every 10 Levels they have (for example, a Level 20 Pokemon would have your Chosen Stat's base value increased by +3). Additionally, your Pokemon may ignore Base Relations, as long as they are adding to the Stat chosen for Stat Ace, and you do not need to “correct” Stats due to this inflated Stat Value.

When you take Stat Ace, choose Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, or Speed. This becomes your Pokemon's Chosen Stat. You may take Stat Ace multiple times, choosing different Stats each time. If using Style Expert to qualify for Stat Ace, your Chosen Stat must be the Stat that correlates to your Chosen Contest Stat. Beauty is Special Attack, Cool is Attack, Cute is Speed, Smart is Special Defense, and Tough is Defense. You may use the Stat in place of "Stat" in all Stat Ace features on this sheet, e.g. "Attack Ace" or "Special Defense Link".

fieldReview.recordValue:
Trigger: A Weather Condition created by you or an ally would be dissipated by a means other than Tier 3 Weather. 

Effect: You may spend X AP, where X is equal to the Tier of the Weather that would be dissipated. The Weather Condition doesn't dissipate and gains up to 3 additional rounds of duration to a maximum of the starting value of the weather. If the triggering condition was another due to another Tier 1 or Tier 2 Weather Condition being created, the Weather Condition instead attempts to overwrite the triggering Weather Condition. The Weather Condition is dissipated if it fails to overwrite the triggering Weather Condition in this way.

fieldReview.recordValue:
Effect: Whenever you perform your hour of exercise from the Athlete feat you choose a Physical Dedication from the below list, selecting one for which you have the associated Edge. You gain the bonus from that Dedication, the Move and Advanced Maneuver associated with it. You may only be Trained in one Dedication at a time and will lose these bonuses at the end of the next Extended Rest.
### Physical Dedications
#### Fieldsman
Prerequisite: Athletic Initiative
Effect: You gain +4 to Initiative, and add Rock Climb as an Athlete Move to your list of Moves. You receive the Empower Ability.
#### "Cyclist"
Prerequisite: Mounted Prowess
Effect: When you Shift using a Bicycle, your Overland Speed is increased by +2 your Long Jump and High Jump by +1, and you add Barreling Charge to your list of Moves. You gain a +10 Bonus to Damage with Athlete Moves while on a Bicycle or another Mount.
#### Powerhouse
Prerequisite: Power Boost
Effect: Increase your Power Capability by +1 and add Wring Out as an Athlete Move to your list of Moves. You gain a +2 bonus to checks related to Grappling. If you have Dominance while Grappling and choose to end the Grapple, you may Push the other person as a Rapid Action (this maneuver is considered related to Grappling). If you succeed in Pushing the target, they are Pushed 1 additional meter and are Tripped.
#### Marathonman
Prerequisite: Stamina
Effect: You gain +2 to Save Checks and add Refresh as an Athlete Move to your list of Moves. Whenever you regain Hit Points, you receive Temporary Hit Points equal to your Athletics Rank, and whenever you gain Temporary Hit Points, that amount is increased by an amount equal to your Athletics Rank.
#### Tidemaster
Prerequisite: Swimmer
Effect: Increase your Swim Speed by +1 and add Dive as an Athlete Move to your list of Moves. While Swimming, you gain +2 Evasion, +3 to Opposed Combat Maneuver Checks, and, against Water Type attacks, 5 Damage Reduction.
